hints.title: Persistent Buffer Cursor Architecture
hints.text: Multiple subsequent calls require keeping leftover unconsumed characters from previous block operations in persistent state across invocations.

hints.title: Pointers Across Staging Buffer
hints.text: Store a 4-element intermediate array with head and tail index markers. Only read from the external reader when the internal buffer is completely depleted.

hints.title: Buffer Refill and Drain Protocol
hints.text: While items are needed: if head equals tail, reset head to 0 and set tail to read4. If tail is 0, break. While items needed and head < tail, copy buf4[head] to destination and advance.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of characters read across calls
complexity.notes: Each character is staged into and out of the internal buffer exactly once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Discarding leftover items between calls loses stream synchronization and corrupts sequential data.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Persistent 4-byte internal queue eliminates redundant external reads.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct persistent head and tail cursor lifecycle across arbitrary call sizes.
